description: LiveAgent helpdesk with API v3 key authentication and a built-in MCP server.
auth_notes: Separate API keys for v1 (deprecated) and v3; v3 keys managed under Configuration > System > API with per-key permissions.
gate_detail: Account holders generate keys in Configuration > System > API. Pricing page shows paid plans with Start free trial and no free plan; MCP server is listed on the Business plan.
api_scope: API v3 (current) and deprecated v1 with a Swagger descriptor; permissions per key cover actions such as reading tickets and posting messages.
mcp_notes: Built-in LiveAgent MCP server with a tools reference; listed on the Business plan. URL not stated.
blocker_detail: Only a free trial is shown; ongoing use needs a paid per-agent plan, and MCP needs Business.
